headline: Côte d'Ivoire Targets 500,000 Barrels/Day Oil Output by 2040
summary: Côte d’Ivoire aims to triple crude production to 300,000 barrels per day by 2030 and reach 500,000 barrels per day by 2040, supported by investment-friendly policies.

impacts.name: Ivory Coast
impacts.why: Upstream petroleum capacity expansions target increased long-term hydrocarbon export earnings.
